achievements.name: Fergus saved
achievements.description: In the Chapter 1 timeline decision, choose to save Fergus (starts the Fergus campaign).

achievements.name: Wyatt saved
achievements.description: In the Chapter 1 timeline decision, choose to save Wyatt (starts the Wyatt campaign).

achievements.name: Vive la resistance!
achievements.description: Reach and join the Kreisau Circle resistance.

achievements.name: Power to the laser
achievements.description: Acquire the LaserKraftWerk.

achievements.name: Hidden in the deep
achievements.description: Complete the deep-sea / U-boat chapter.

achievements.name: London uprising
achievements.description: Complete the London Nautica assault.

achievements.name: Deliverance
achievements.description: Reach the final assault on Deathshead's compound.

achievements.name: Liberation
achievements.description: Complete the game on any difficulty.

achievements.name: Super hero
achievements.description: Complete the game on I AM DEATH INCARNATE! difficulty or higher.

achievements.name: Über hero
achievements.description: Complete the game on ÜBER difficulty.

achievements.name: All that glitters
achievements.description: Collect 25 gold items.

achievements.name: Heart of gold
achievements.description: Collect every gold item.

achievements.name: The lives of others
achievements.description: Collect every letter.

achievements.name: Secrets revealed I
achievements.description: Solve the first Enigma code.

achievements.name: Secrets revealed II
achievements.description: Solve the second Enigma code.

achievements.name: Secrets revealed III
achievements.description: Solve the third Enigma code.

achievements.name: Secrets revealed IV
achievements.description: Solve the fourth Enigma code.

achievements.name: Scout I

achievements.name: Knife throwing

achievements.name: Knife sheath +
achievements.description: Unlock the Knife Sheath + perk - more thrown-knife kills.

achievements.name: Knife sheath ++
achievements.description: Unlock the Knife Sheath ++ perk - still more thrown-knife kills.

achievements.name: Silent shot
achievements.description: Unlock the Silent Shot perk - get 10 silent kills with a silenced pistol.

achievements.name: Vampire
achievements.description: Unlock the Vampire perk - perform 5 stealth takedowns while overcharged.

achievements.name: Scout II
achievements.description: Unlock the Scout II perk - stealth-kill more Commanders / mark enemies.

achievements.name: Assassin
achievements.description: Unlock the Assassin perk - 50 stealth kills on soldiers plus 5 on Kampfhunds.

achievements.name: Deadeye
achievements.description: Unlock the Deadeye perk - assault-rifle and pistol headshots.

achievements.name: Quick draw
achievements.description: Unlock the Quick Draw perk - 40 headshots while aiming down sights.

achievements.name: Quick regeneration
achievements.description: Unlock the Quick Regeneration perk - pick up health while already full.

achievements.name: Gun magazine +
achievements.description: Unlock the Gun Magazine + perk - kills with the pistol.

achievements.name: Shotgun magazine +
achievements.description: Unlock the Shotgun Magazine + perk - kills with the shotgun.

achievements.name: AR magazine +
achievements.description: Unlock the AR Magazine + perk - kills with an assault rifle.

achievements.name: Marksman magazine +
achievements.description: Unlock the Marksman Magazine + perk - kills with the marksman rifle.

achievements.name: Quick reload
achievements.description: Unlock the Quick Reload perk - perform many reloads.

achievements.name: Double reload
achievements.description: Unlock the Double Reload perk - reload two dual-wielded weapons at once repeatedly.

achievements.name: Endurance I
achievements.description: Unlock the Endurance I perk - 3 kills while sprint-sliding.

achievements.name: Scavenger
achievements.description: Unlock the Scavenger perk - 3 dual-wield assault-rifle kills in a row without releasing fire.

achievements.name: Bullet feeder
achievements.description: Unlock the Bullet Feeder perk - pick up ammo from many corpses.

achievements.name: Endurance II
achievements.description: Unlock the Endurance II perk - more sprint-slide kills.

achievements.name: Sentinel

achievements.name: Hardened
achievements.description: Unlock the Hardened perk - take heavy damage and survive repeatedly.
